root.label: Google Earth launches AI image-generation tool

events.label: Google Earth launches AI image-generation tool

slots.name: availability duration
slots.sentence: For about 24 hours beginning on Thursday, the tool became even more potent, when a six-word instruction — “type whatever you want to see” — allowed billions of Google Earth users worldwide to use a new artificial intelligence feature to create deepfake aerial images.

events.label: Google Earth disables AI image-generation tool

slots.name: feature status
slots.sentence: and on Friday, one day after heralding the new feature, the company announced that it was disabling it.
